hostname ix-w01
!
ip access-list acl-w-nat permit ip src 198.51.100.0/24 dest any
ip access-list sec-list-w permit ip src any dest any
!
ip route default GigaEthernet0.1
ip route 192.0.2.0/25 Tunnel0.0
ip dhcp enable
ip dhcp excluded-address 198.51.100.1 198.51.100.10
!
ike proposal ike-prop-w encryption aes-256 hash sha2-256 group 2048-bit lifetime 28800
ike policy ike-pol-w peer 203.0.113.20 key dummy-psk-site-w ike-prop-w
ike keepalive ike-pol-w 30 3
!
ipsec autokey-proposal sec-prop-w esp-aes-256 esp-sha lifetime time 3600
ipsec autokey-map sec-map-w sec-list-w peer 203.0.113.20 pfs 2048-bit sec-prop-w
!
ppp profile ppp-w
  authentication myname sample-w@example.com
  authentication password sample-w@example.com dummy-pppoe-secret-w
!
ip dhcp profile pool-w-lan
  default-gateway 198.51.100.1
  dns-server 192.0.2.53
  lease-time 86400
!
interface GigaEthernet0.0
  description sample wan port
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet1.0
  description sample lan
  ip address 198.51.100.1/24
  ip dhcp binding pool-w-lan
  no shutdown
!
interface GigaEthernet0.1
  description sample pppoe
  ppp binding ppp-w
  ip address ipcp
  ip mtu 1454
  ip tcp adjust-mss 1414
  ip napt enable
  ip napt inside list acl-w-nat
  no shutdown
!
interface Tunnel0.0
  description sample vpn
  tunnel mode ipsec
  ip unnumbered GigaEthernet1.0
  ip tcp adjust-mss 1300
  ipsec policy tunnel sec-map-w out
  no shutdown
!
